evidenceActuallyInspected.testRecord: 23 recorded tests pass; 567 geometry samples report no mismatches/invalid values. Browser records report theme parity, unchanged curious control, exact return, frozen paused resize and continuous first replay pose. I inspected the records, not reran or personally browser-verified them.

strengths: The offering hand is now visibly separated farther from the ruff and rotates into a small upward cup. At 160/240px and in the actual portrait return it reads to this reviewer as a more deliberate open gesture than the earlier compact thumb-like shape; the tiny mitten anatomy is intact.

Thinking’s lowered free hand leaves one high chin-contact action; Focused has two low separate mittens; Grateful’s lower clasp has a clearer two-lobe seam. Worried retains a diagonal relation rather than becoming another symmetric clasp. These improve the set’s contour organization without manufacturing fingers or longer arms.

Matched 390px day/night investigation images show the head/gaze supported upward toward the actual question during 790–1900ms. At 2350ms the visitor-facing return is restored and the 2720ms offer remains authored. Source limits the composition mapper to five attention channels in two study variants and uses the actual heading bearing.

The matched before/current and actual-size evidence supplies better comparison control than isolated attractive stills. Original anatomy/paint and signature CSS are unchanged, and the same measured composition uses the same numeric pose in both themes.

Nag’s selected Investigate & share direction and the real eva.md question remain stable. The new work strengthens an existing association hypothesis rather than inventing a new personality or project result.

resolvedOrReducedPriorLimits: The specific phone scene problem of retaining lateral/downward investigation against an above-head question is materially reduced in the actual matched DOM samples and supported by measured upward bearings. Exact perceived line of sight, continuous transitions and human comprehension remain unmeasured.

Offer/ruff contact density is reduced without changing anatomy. Source and sampled sequence preserve consideration, return and one outward offer; they do not prove the wrist turn feels natural at normal speed.

The prior small night-avatar stem limitation is unaffected: character paint and avatar assets were not revised in this scope. Retain earlier use guidance rather than awarding a repair or applying a new deduction based on uninspected exports.

audienceOutcomes.reason: No unfamiliar-human results or new preference measurement. Nag’s existing categorical owner choice remains personal-fit evidence only.

improvementCriteria: For a future consequential action-comprehension question, show one full-size neutral clip and collect free descriptions before suggesting sharing/greeting/acknowledging categories. Preserve the selected anatomy unless recurring evidence identifies a specific ambiguity.

Keep a separate natural branded exposure for owner attribution and delayed recall. Record source version, viewport/crop/scroll, actual name/moth visibility, exposure duration, theme and playback state; unaided recall precedes recognition alternatives.

Inspect continuous normal-speed offer and return in actual portrait composition to determine whether the 2350–2720ms wrist turn reads as one offer or an unintended flick. Frame continuity and tests alone cannot decide that.

If an application uses Grateful/Shy or Thinking/Focused as distinct messages, test those few relevant contrasts at the intended size before another broad pose pass. No blanket enlargement or extra motion is warranted.
confidence: Moderate overall expert craft/readiness judgment; high confidence in matched framing/source changes and evidence boundaries, moderate in static semantic readings, no empirical audience confidence.
implementedAssessment: Accept the inspected update as a meaningful refinement of the same local foundation, with remaining readiness and perceptual limits. No blocking source defect found in this role’s scope; no new source edit or recruitment requested.
limits: Primed AI reviewer; no human observations, recall results or attachment evidence.

The phone film uses a simplified measured-bearing composition; actual DOM evidence takes precedence for layout judgments.
No source changes, publication or deployment in this review.

For every comparison image, log the actual crop/scroll and whether brand name and character coexist; the newly visible footer here is a capture fact, not a source improvement.
Treat greater geometric consistency as a more credible test stimulus, not a positive human result. Keep neutral action exposure separate from contextual brand memory exposure.
